meaning:
πλατύνω
(πλατύς), [in LXX chiefly for רָחַב hi. ;]
to make broad, enlarge, extend: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.23:5. Metaphorical (cf. Psa.119:32, al.), pass., ἡ καρδία, 2Co.6:11; ὑμεῖς, 2Co.6:13.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad, enlarge the fringes of their garments,
Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
